title: PH's John Wayne Alba concludes Mister International 2026 journey with Top 10 finish
summary: John Wayne Alba concludes his Mister International 2026 journey with a Top 10 finish, falling short to keep the crown in the terrain of the Philippines on Saturday, September 26.
